beats.text:

The "truce" word void is also noteworthy, suggesting a model avoidance of discussing ceasefires or negotiated settlements.

The top EigenChing states include "The Unanimous Shield" and "The Clear Channel," suggesting a pattern of unified reporting or clear, unobstructed information flow.

The average VIX (Volatility Index) scores for all models are relatively high, indicating that there was a lot of uncertainty and volatility in the data today. The model with the lowest score is Grok at 15.16 but this is still quite high.
